data.name: Marziyah
data.long_meaning: Marziyah is an Arabic origin name that means 'wished for' or 'desired'. It is a name that reflects the joy and happiness of having a child.

The name Marziyah signifies the parents' deepest wishes and desires for their child, as well as their hope for a bright and prosperous future. This hadith highlights the importance of love and desire in the relationship between parents and their children.

It also reminds us of the hadith, "The closest that man can come to God is through his child," emphasizing the special connection between parents and their children as a reflection of the relationship between God and His creation.
